name: Order Of The Undead
source:
Enya was supposed to live happily ever after with the love of her life, but when he’s ripped away from her in an instant, her world is shattered, and she’ll stop at nothing to bring him back, even if that means making a deal with Death himself.

[From [url=https://chanchangames.itch.io/order-of-the-undead]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
恩雅本应与她一生的挚爱幸福地生活在一起，但当他瞬间从她身边夺走时，她的世界就破碎了，她会不惜一切代价把他带回来，即使这意味着与死神本人做一笔交易。

[来自[url=https://chanchangames.itch.io/order-of-the-undead]itch.io[/url]]
